verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bulk operation, such as batch create, update or delete of many records. The SDK snippet creates one Task at a time, and the CRUD and Data-page mentions do not describe acting on many items at once. The global theme setting ("updated everywhere at once") and AI agents that "update records" are adjacent features, not a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
